::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan 9th [1866]  
**From:** Elderfield Otterbourn  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection, CO171: Box 29
:::

My dear [Miss Erskine](people/person_489.qmd)
I have asked Ivanovna to write to you herself as what I know comes chiefly from her. She is [Miss Johanna Batty](people/person_126.qmd), I believe her father was a general, and she is very learned in all charities.[^1]

In haste yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Ivanovna ontributed to the *MP* 1861-1891, but chiefly in the 1860s. She wrote on such topics as Needlewoman’s Institution, Mission Work at Home, Industrial Charities.
